summary: Narrow strip tight against a warehouse wall in an industrial yard.
reasons: Working yard with trucks and vehicles

drivers.seclusion: Industrial estate with no homes, but the strip sits against the Andonis Cafe and Bar building and warehouses in active use.
drivers.access_and_room: Outline runs along a building wall, mostly in shadow; no clear bay or tyre marks, and the mapped footprint overlaps the cafe building. The open concrete yard nearby is working space.
drivers.traffic: Trucks and workers in the yard; cafe customers during the day.
drivers.convention: No overnight convention; cars in the yard belong to businesses.
